Looks interesting. Like the style.

Couple of ideas to make it more juicy (I'm sure you were gonna do this anyway, but just so you don't forget – it's the little details that make the game):

  1. Not enough screen shake on bazooka hit.
  2. Not enough recoil (moving the character in the opposite direction than he's shooting – even a little helps; but don't do this with the bazooka! It's traditionally a recoil-less weapon).
  3. Not enough on-hit feedback by the boss (even a little nudge in the direction he's been hit or a few particle effects).
  4. Floor not interesting enough. Tiles (crates etc.) should have a little variety.

Good luck!

P.S.: I recommend this great presentation: Gamasutra – Video: Is your game 'juicy' enough?
